title: Latin text through Naibbe-like homophone substitution against all 27 established facts
method: Classical Latin text from pinned corpora encrypted with a homophone substitution cipher: each of the 25 classical Latin letters maps to 3 Voynich glyph-sequences (homophones), chosen randomly at encryption time. All 21 Voynich glyphs are guaranteed as first characters across the homophone set, preserving realistic character diversity. Spaces preserved as word breaks. Word lengths follow natural Latin distribution. No target patterns in rules. Fitted on public training pages only.
